text:
maya: deploy-bot paused the promotion — staging canaries failing during artifact push. Multipart uploads keep timing out and the shared cache shows high eviction/queue.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_upload_backpressure).

maya: Paste from uploader:
```
uploader: chunk write timeout after 27s
registry: 503 slow_down x 40
cache: shard-5 queue_depth=720 evictions=high
```

rahul: Saw similar last week. Immediate options: reduce multipart concurrency, route to fallback registry in eu-west, or pin to last-known-good SHA and rerun CI. Given the change window in ~35m, pin seems lowest risk.

release-coordinator: Agreed. Pinning avoids forcing a rollback mid-window. We'll document the pin in release notes and include the rollback decision matrix.

maya: Opening promo-pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/2865432100 — pinned to sha256:12f9b8e3. Note: "manual pin due to artifact upload backpressure and cache shard eviction storm". Rerun will use multipart_concurrency=3.

ci-bot: Rerun queued on pinned image: pipeline #5240 (staged).

infra-oncall: Investigating shard-5. Observing write amplification from many small chunk uploads; temporarily scaling shard group and raising write buffer. Collecting metrics (P50/P95/P99) and uploader traces. ETA ~7m.

rahul: Adding a short postmortem checklist to the ticket: uploader logs, shard write latency, registry 503 counts, deploy-bot backpressure counters, and multipart chunk size distribution.

release-coordinator: I'll update release notes: "Cut held — pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact upload backpressure; infra investigating cache shard tail latencies." Marking the promotion as "held - pinned" on the tracker. If infra stabilizes inside the window we can unpin and proceed; otherwise we'll move the promo to the next change window.

maya: Tagging infra oncall: @infra-oncall — please shout if you can unpin and proceed.

infra-oncall: Quick update: scaled shard group and bumped buffer. Queue depth trending down and 503s decreasing. Recommend waiting 5m for stability before deciding to unpin.

release-coordinator: Hold for 5m then reassess. Posting updates to #release-updates.

maya: Promo pinned and blocked. Will post final decision after the stability window.
